question.text: FCFF = 100, Depreciation = 20, CapEx = 30, Working-capital change = 10. Given EBIT(1-T) = 100, confirm FCFF =:

explanation.text: The Logic: FCFF = EBIT(1-T) + Dep - CapEx - WC change = 100 + 20 - 30 - 10 = 80. Verify matches. The Trap: Sign errors yield the other options. Cross-Exam Context: Same formula in XV. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Always sign-check CapEx and WC changes; sign confusion is the #1 DCF error.
